camel_example: aliyun iot AsyncRRpc --region cn-hangzhou --MessageContent 'eyJ0ZXN0IjoidGFzayBwdWIgYnJvYWRjYXN0In0=' --ProductKey aldfeSe0000 --DeviceName device1
description_en: Sends a message to a specified device
description_zh: 调用该接口向指定设备发送消息
kebab_example: aliyun iot async-rrpc --product-key aldfeSe0000 --device-name device1 --message-content eyJ0ZXN0IjoidGFzayBwdWIgYnJvYWRjYXN0In0= --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AsyncRRpc

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device that receives the message belongs
parameters.help_zh: 要接收消息的设备所属产品的ProductKey
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The device name of the device that accepts the message
parameters.help_zh: 要接收消息的设备名称
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
When sending a message to a device that uses the cloud gateway GB/T 32960 protocol, you must specify this parameter to indicate the command type of the message. Valid values:

128: query command (0x80).
129: setting command (0x81).
130: vehicle terminal control command (0x82).


For more information about device access using the cloud gateway GB/T 32960 protocol, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2248990.html
parameters.help_zh:
发送消息给云网关GB/T 32960协议的设备时，需要传入此参数，标识消息的命令类型，可取值：

128：查询命令（0x80）。
129：设置命令（0x81）。
130：车载终端控制命令（0x82）。


云网关GB/T 32960协议的设备接入详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2248990.html
parameters.name: ext_info

parameters.help_en:
The message body to send.

You must convert the original message to binary data and then perform Base64 encoding to generate the message body
parameters.help_zh:
要发送的消息主体。

您需要将消息原文转换成二进制数据，并进行Base64编码，从而生成消息主体
parameters.name: message_content

parameters.help_en:
When sending a message to an MQTT protocol device, you must specify the custom topic of the corresponding device. The operation permission of the topic must be Subscribe or Publish and Subscribe.

When sending a message to a device that uses the cloud gateway GB/T 32960 protocol, you do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
发送消息给MQTT协议设备时，需要传入对应设备的自定义Topic。Topic的操作权限必须为订阅或发布和订阅。

发送消息给云网关GB/T 32960协议的设备时，无需传入此参数
parameters.name: topic_full_name

Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回错误码。详细信息，请参见下文错误码
